Bill.BriefDescription: Describing the duties of the combined fund drive.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the combined fund drive; and adding new sectionsto chapter 41.04 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 41.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The Washington state combined fund drive's powers and dutiesinclude but are not limited to the following: (1) Raising money for charity and reducing the disruption togovernment through multiple fund drives; (2) Establishing criteria by which a public or private nonprofitorganization may participate in the combined fund drive; (3) Engaging in or encouraging fundraising activities includingthe solicitation of charitable gifts, grants, and donations from stateemployees, retired public employees, corporations, foundations, andother individuals for the benefit of the beneficiaries of theWashington state combined fund drive; (4) Requesting the appointment of employees from state agencies andinstitutions of higher education to lead and manage workplacecharitable giving campaigns within state government; p. 1 SB 5156 (5) Engaging in educational activities, including classes,exhibits, seminars, workshops, and conferences related to the basicpurpose of the combined fund drive; (6) Accepting gifts and grants from private institutions, persons,firms, or corporations, and engaging in appropriate fundraising andadvertising activities to increasing the selfsupport of theadministrative duties of the Washington state combined fund drive; and (7) Charging an administrative fee to the beneficiaries of theWashington state combined fund drive to fund the administrative dutiesof the program.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 41.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The Washington state combined fund drive committee may enter intocontracts and partnerships with private institutions, persons, firms,or corporations for the benefit of the beneficiaries of the Washingtonstate combined fund drive.
